title: The forgotten strips
hook: (10 + 3) squared: is it just 10 squared plus 3 squared? Cut the square and count.

knows: area of a square and a rectangle
doesNotKnow: that (a + b)² has two equal cross rectangles, 2ab

objective: The learner can explain, from the cut square, that (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b², and that a² + b² misses the two a by b strips.

claims.text: A square of side a + b cut at a on both sides splits into an a by a square, a b by b square and two a by b strips.
claims.source: Geometry of the cut; the stage draws the four rectangles from a and N - a on a unit grid.
Expand (a + b)(a + b) = a² + ab + ba + b²; equals the sum of the four pieces.
Recomputed with node; the question, caption and reveal compute from N = 13 and the key split 10.

claims.text: Wherever the cut is, the four pieces add up to the same 169.
claims.source: a² + 2a(13 - a) + (13 - a)² = 169 for every a; the slider caption computes it for each a.

recall.question: What is (20 + 1)², that is, 21 × 21?
recall.why: Two squares, 400 and 1, plus two strips of 20 × 1: 400 + 20 + 20 + 1 = 441. 401 forgets the strips.
